source.text:
name: Isolated Gemini A/B (manual only)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm_billable_requests:
        description: 'Type YES to authorize billable synthetic Gemini requests (quality: 8 calls; latency: 2 or 40)'
        required: true
        type: string
      experiment:
        description: 'Latency/token or four-scenario quality A/B'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: 'latency'
        options:
          - 'latency'
          - 'quality'
      fixture:
        description: 'Synthetic fixture: short or long (approx. 12k chars + 60 history messages)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: 'short'
        options:
          - 'short'
          - 'long'
      delay_ms:
        description: 'Delay between Gemini requests in milliseconds (0 or 10000)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: '10000'
        options:
          - '0'
          - '10000'
      quality_history:
        description: 'Quality scenarios: short or 60-message synthetic history (quality mode only)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: 'short'
        options:
          - 'short'
          - 'long'
      runs_per_variant:
        description: 'Runs per variant: 1 (2 requests) or 20 (40 requests)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: '1'
        options:
          - '1'
          - '20'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  isolated-ab:
    if: ${{ github.event.inputs.confirm_billable_requests == 'YES' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pinned experiment commit (not Production)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 9a40d98c4ecec2f17eef1489a687acc1e24f338e
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/context-ab-*.test.ts
      - name: Run explicitly approved synthetic Gemini A/B requests
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MISAKI_AB_GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          MISAKI_AB_LIVE: 'YES'
          MISAKI_AB_MODEL: gemini-3.1-flash-lite
          MISAKI_AB_RUNS: ${{ inputs.runs_per_variant }}
          MISAKI_AB_FIXTURE: ${{ inputs.fixture }}
          MISAKI_AB_DELAY_MS: ${{ inputs.delay_ms }}
          MISAKI_AB_QUALITY_HISTORY: ${{ inputs.quality_history }}
          MISAKI_AB_EXPORT_REVIEW: ${{ inputs.experiment == 'quality' && 'YES' || 'NO' }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$GEMINI_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo 'Secret missing; refusing live calls.'
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "${{ inputs.experiment }}" = "quality" ]; then
            node --experimental-strip-types scripts/context-ab-quality-live.ts
          else
            node --experimental-strip-types scripts/context-ab-live.ts
          fi
      - name: Upload blinded synthetic replies for human review
        if: ${{ success() && inputs.experiment == 'quality' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: synthetic-blind-review
          path: ab-review-output/blind-review.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Upload separate answer key
        if: ${{ success() && inputs.experiment == 'quality' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: synthetic-review-key
          path: ab-review-output/blind-key.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
